label: dormwarssix2
title_zh: 运动大爆发！和 Karin 一起保持身材！

lines.en: label dormwarssix2:
scene rocketshadowlegends
HEY! IT’S US AGAIN! AND WE’RE NEVER GOING AWAY!
lines.zh: 嘿！又是我们！而且我们永远不会消失！

lines.en: {size=-4}BUT THE GREAT NEWS IS THAT RAID: SHADOW LEGENDS IS NOW ROCKET MONEY: SHADOW LEGENDS! AND WITH THE HELP OF SPIRIT HALLOWEEN, HOLIDAY INN, COCA-COLA, AND NORD VPN, WE’RE GOING TO PUT THE FIRST EVER ARBY’S ON THE FUCKING MOON!!! HOLY SHIT!!!!{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}但好消息是：RAID: SHADOW LEGENDS 现在改叫 ROCKET MONEY: SHADOW LEGENDS 了！而在 SPIRIT HALLOWEEN、HOLIDAY INN、COCA-COLA 和 NORD VPN 的帮助下，我们要把史上第一家 Arby’s 开到他妈的月亮上去！！！我操！！！！{/size}

lines.en: (This message has been sponsored by OperaGX)
lines.zh: （本消息由 OperaGX 赞助播出）

lines.en: scene makonodowar1
: And we’re back! After a much shorter commercial this time since advertising slots are getting way more pricey now that the Dorm Wars is a nationally beloved event.
lines.zh: : 我们回来了！这次的广告短多了，因为宿舍战争已经成了全国性的热门赛事，广告位也越来越贵了。

lines.en: : Hi, Mom! Hi, Dad! I get to a be a judge again! And for an event much more suited to my tastes than the one swimsuit contest that got really weird really quickly a while back.
lines.zh: : 嗨，妈！嗨，爸！我又当上评委啦！而且这回的活动比之前那场迅速变得很诡异的泳装比赛合我胃口多了。

lines.en: scene makonodowar2
: Sorry, is this one not weird yet? Because Nodoka’s kind of only wearing a bra and I’m worried about what this is going to do to our ratings.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，这场难道不诡异吗？Nodoka 只穿了件胸罩吧，我担心这会对我们的收视率有什么影响。

lines.en: : Probably increase ‘em, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 搞不好会涨，说实话。

lines.en: : How about you take your shirt off as well, Makoto? Exhibitionism is socially acceptable so long as you can conceal it under the guise of exercise.
lines.zh: : Makoto，你也把上衣脱了怎么样？只要能借着运动的名义掩饰，暴露癖在社会上是能被接受的。

lines.en: : Exhibitionism? You mean like an...exhibition match?
lines.zh: : 暴露癖？你是说……表演赛那种？

lines.en: scene makonodowar3
: If that answer brings you closer to removing your shirt as well, then yes. That is precisely what I meant.
lines.zh: : 如果这个答案能让你也把上衣脱掉，那就是。我正是这个意思。

lines.en: : Gonna stop you right there, Nodoka. Karin’s the last remaining member of the “do not corrupt” list and I don’t want you seducing her no matter how socially acceptable it may currently be.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿就要打断你了，Nodoka。Karin 是「禁止污染」名单上仅存的最后一位，不管眼下这么做有多符合社会规范，我都不想让你去勾引她。

lines.en: scene makonodowar4
: S...Seduce?! That’s not what’s happening here, is it?! It’s totally normal to wear an outfit like Nodoka’s while exercising! I just...don’t do that myself because of...reasons.
lines.zh: : 勾……勾引？！这里根本不是那么回事吧？！运动时穿 Nodoka 那样的衣服完全正常！我只是……自己不这么穿，因为……一些原因。

lines.en: : Yes, and we’re all very envious of your “reasons.” But Nodoka’s not the type to be trusted in basically any situation ever and I’m sure she just wants to show off right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我们都非常羡慕你的「原因」。但 Nodoka 在任何情况下都不值得信任，我敢肯定她现在就是想显摆。

lines.en: : Show off {i}what,{/i} exactly? My body isn’t nearly as impressive as any of yours. I’m just dressing the part, is all.
lines.zh: : 显摆{i}什么{/i}啊？我的身材可远不如你们任何一个。我只是穿得应景罢了。

lines.en: : See?! Totally normal. She just likes exhibitionism.
lines.zh: : 看吧？！完全正常。她只是喜欢暴露罢了。

lines.en: : Never change, Karin. Like, really. I don’t want to see what you become.
lines.zh: : 千万别变，Karin。真的。我可不想看到你变成什么样。

lines.en: scene makonodowar5
: So, like...what is the goal here, exactly? Is this any different from the contest Miku and Kirin took place in several years ago? Or-
lines.zh: : 那么……具体目标是什么来着？这跟几年前 Miku 和 Kirin 参加的那个比赛有什么不一样吗？还是——

lines.en: : I’m glad you asked, Makoto! Because if we stalled any longer, we might not even {i}make{/i} it to our second televised contest of the day! Why don’t you go ahead and tell ‘em, Karin?
lines.zh: : 很高兴你问了，Makoto！因为再拖下去，我们今天可能连第二场电视转播比赛都{i}赶不上{/i}了！Karin，你来说给大家听吧？

lines.en: scene makonodowar6
: R-Right! So, as I’m sure you’ve already heard, this will be a full-body fitness competition. And each of you will be judged based on three categories: stamina, agility, and strength.
lines.zh: : 好……好的！那么，正如大家已经听说的，这将是一场全身体能比赛。你们每个人都会按三个项目评分：耐力、敏捷和力量。

lines.en: : Full body, you say? But I’ve yet to do any of my stretches. You wouldn’t mind helping me out, would you, Karin?
lines.zh: : 全身？可我还没做拉伸呢。你不会介意帮帮我吧，Karin？

lines.en: : Of course I can! That’s-
lines.zh: : 我当然可以！那是——

lines.en: : Nope! That’d be grounds for disqualification.
lines.zh: : 不行！那是要被取消资格的。

lines.en: scene makonodowar7
: But stretching before rigorous exercise is important. And I help her all the time in the locker room at swim club.
lines.zh: : 可在剧烈运动前拉伸很重要啊。而且我在游泳社的更衣室里经常帮她的。

lines.en: : Oh. So {i}that’s{/i} what those noises are.
lines.zh: : 哦。原来{i}那{/i}就是那些声音的由来。

lines.en: : Nodoka.
lines.zh: : Nodoka。

lines.en: : What can I say? I’m a very {i}tense{/i} girl. And I require a great deal of both attention {i}and{/i} assistance.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢？我是个很{i}紧绷{/i}的女孩。而且我既需要大量关注，{i}也{/i}需要大量协助。

lines.en: : She really is. Even the slightest touch normally makes her-
lines.zh: : 她确实是。哪怕最轻微的触碰通常都会让她——

lines.en: scene makonodowar8
: Three stages! Stamina! Agility! Strength! Whoever wins two out of three rounds will be crowned the winner!
lines.zh: : 三个环节！耐力！敏捷！力量！三局两胜者即为冠军！

lines.en: : And, in the event that neither of these two weaklings are able to finish any of the competitions, the win will go to whoever finishes {i}one{/i} round!
lines.zh: : 而且，如果这两个弱鸡一个项目都完不成，那么谁完成{i}一{/i}个环节谁就获胜！

lines.en: scene makonodowar9
: Or just...whoever did the best if you two can’t finish any of Karin’s tests. She’ll just choose a winner if that’s the case, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者……如果你们俩 Karin 的测试一个都完不成，那就看谁表现最好。那种情况下她大概就直接挑一个赢家吧。

lines.en: : So Sensei’s just not involved in any capacity and this will be an entirely unbiased competition based on skill and merit rather than who he likes the most?
lines.zh: : 也就是说 Sensei 完全不参与，这将是一场纯粹按技术和实力、而不是按他最喜欢谁来评判的公正比赛？

lines.en: : Right.
scene makonodowar10
: Shit.
scene makonodowar11
: Is something the matter, Makoto? You don’t believe yourself to be inferior to me {i}physically{/i} as well, do you?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Makoto？你不会觉得自己在{i}体力{/i}上也输给我吧？

lines.en: : I’m not sure, to be honest. I imagine most other girls would have just died after what Yumi did to you in the classroom. So I believe there’s a good chance you could be hiding something here.
lines.zh: : 说实话我不太确定。换作别的女生，被 Yumi 在教室里那么搞过之后大概早就死了。所以我觉得你很可能在这儿藏着什么。

lines.en: : You’re more than welcome to strip search me if you’re {i}that{/i} worried.
lines.zh: : 你要是{i}这么{/i}担心，尽管来搜身。

lines.en: : Something {i}mental.{/i} I have no interest in seeing you naked.
lines.zh: : 我说的是{i}心理层面{/i}的。我没兴趣看你裸体。

lines.en: : Aww, not even a little? I guess we’re not as similar as I thought then. How sad.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，一点都没有？那看来我们没我想的那么像。真让人难过。

lines.en: scene makonodowar12
: Can we just start this thing already? I’d rather just lose than stand here while this psychopath pretends to hit on me.
lines.zh: : 能赶紧开始吗？我宁可直接输掉，也不想站在这儿被这个疯子假装搭讪。

lines.en: : Bitch, no you wouldn’t. You hate losing more than anybody I know.
lines.zh: : 少来，你才不想。你比我认识的任何人都更讨厌输。

lines.en: : Kiss me and I’ll {i}let{/i} you win. How about that?
lines.zh: : 亲我一下，我就{i}让{/i}你赢。怎么样？

lines.en: scene makonodowar13
: No! It’s not winning if you {i}let{/i} me do it! And I’m one of the few girls in our class who {i}isn’t{/i} gay!
lines.zh: : 不！你{i}让{/i}我赢那就不算赢！而且我是我们班少数几个{i}不是{/i}同性恋的女生之一！

lines.en: : N-Nodoka’s gay?!
lines.zh: : N……Nodoka 是同性恋？！

lines.en: scene makonodowar14
: I’m just Nodoka. You can use whatever word for me you’d like.
lines.zh: : 我只是 Nodoka。你想用哪个词形容我都行。

lines.en: : Then how about “loser?” Let’s do this.
lines.zh: : 那「输家」怎么样？开始吧。

lines.en: scene makonodowar15
: Playing hard to get will only make me love you more.
lines.zh: : 欲擒故纵只会让我更爱你。

lines.en: : Contestants! On your marks!
lines.zh: : 选手们！各就位！

lines.en: scene noonsky
: Wait, our marks?! Where are our marks?! Which test are we even doing first?!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么就位？！我们在哪儿就位？！我们第一个要测什么啊？！

lines.en: : Oh! S-Sorry! We’ll be testing your stamina first so we can see how it affects the rest of the competition for you. The first one to make it through five laps of the track wins.
lines.zh: : 哦！抱……抱歉！我们会先测耐力，好看看它对你们后面比赛的影响。先跑完跑道五圈的人获胜。

lines.en: : F-Five?! The track is like half a kilometer!
lines.zh: : 五……五圈？！跑道差不多有半公里呢！

lines.en: : Why, yes! It is. And you can line up right over there.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，对啊。就是。你们可以到那边排队。

lines.en: : Ugh...There as in...here? Is this good?
lines.zh: : 呃……那边是指……这儿？这样可以吗？

lines.en: : Mhm! And Nodoka can-
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！然后 Nodoka 可以——

lines.en: : Karin, you need to stop touching her!
lines.zh: : Karin，你别再摸她了！

lines.en: : S-She wasn’t moving on her own! Is...Is it because she’s gay? Should I not-
lines.zh: : 她……她自己不动啊！是……是不是因为她是同性恋？我是不是不该——

lines.en: : No, {i}I{/i} will!
: {i}Aaah!{/i} Please...there’s enough me to go around...
lines.zh: {i}啊啊啊！{/i}拜托……我身上的份量够大家分的……

lines.en: : I’m startin’ to feel like I should’ve just taught middle school instead.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，当初去教初中就好了。

lines.en: : Contestants! On your marks...
lines.zh: : 选手们！各就位……

lines.en: : Get set...
lines.zh: : 预备……

lines.en: : Wait one second. Miku! Cover your ears!
lines.zh: : 等一下。Miku！捂住耳朵！

lines.en: : Thank you, Karin! Done!
lines.zh: : 谢谢提醒，Karin！好了！

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene makonodowar16
: Ngh!
: Have fun, Makoto! Until we meet again~
lines.zh: : 玩得开心，Makoto！后会有期～

lines.en: : She runs kind of funny...
lines.zh: : 她跑起来还挺滑稽的……

lines.en: : Like a dung beetle but without its ball of excrement.
lines.zh: : 像只蜣螂，只是少了那坨粪球。

lines.en: : Now, I know it’s not my place to say this, but I think you should probably be, um...{i}participating{/i} in this contest, Nodoka. At the very least, for Makoto’s sanity. It’s true that a win isn’t a win if it’s just handed over.
lines.zh: : 我知道不该由我来说，不过我觉得你大概应该……呃……{i}参与{/i}一下这场比赛，Nodoka。至少为了 Makoto 的精神状态。确实，白送的胜利算不上胜利。

lines.en: scene makonodowar17
: Yes, I suppose you’re right. The issue here is that participating right now would involve me running. And, to be honest, I’m not sure if I even know how to do that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你说得对。问题在于，现在参与就意味着我得跑起来。而说实话，我都不确定自己知不知道该怎么跑。

lines.en: : So...this is a calculated move and you’re intentionally abstaining so that Makoto tires herself out prior to the next two rounds?
lines.zh: : 那么……这是有预谋的，你故意弃权，好让 Makoto 在后面两轮之前先把自己累垮？

lines.en: : No. She will likely beat me in those as well. I have no desire to move this body in ways that does not extract pleasure directly from another human being.
lines.zh: : 不是。那两轮她大概也会赢我。我没兴趣用不能直接从别人身上榨取快感的方式挪动这具身体。

lines.en: : I wish I had a net...
lines.zh: : 真希望我有个网兜……

lines.en: scene makonodowar18
: Oh. Hello again, Futaba. Do you like my outfit? I wore it for you.
lines.zh: : 哦。又见面了，Futaba。你喜欢我这身吗？我为你穿的。

lines.en: : Nodoka? Why aren’t you competing? I thought your desire to win Sensei would outweigh your desire to never move your body in ways that do not directly extract pleasure from another human being.
lines.zh: : Nodoka？你怎么不比赛？我以为你想赢 Sensei 的欲望，会盖过你「绝不以不能直接从别人身上榨取快感的方式挪动身体」的欲望。

lines.en: : Which isn’t her telling you to actually compete, by the way. I think this strategy is great. And I’m definitely not just saying that because {i}I{/i} want to win either.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，她可不是在叫你真的去比。我觉得这个策略很棒。而且我绝对不是因为{i}我{/i}想赢才这么说的。

lines.en: : You misunderstand, ladies. There’s no way I’d ever win this round even if I gave it my all.
lines.zh: : 你们误会了，女士们。就算我全力以赴，这一轮我也不可能赢。

lines.en: scene makonodowar19
: I don’t really know how true that is when Makoto’s barely even moved since the gun went off.
lines.zh: : 这话有多真不好说，毕竟枪响之后 Makoto 几乎没动过。

lines.en: : It’s a stamina contest, not a speed one. And let’s be honest here, she’s likely been run through by Akira so many times that she could go {i}ten{/i} laps without needing to catch her breath.
lines.zh: : 这是耐力赛，不是速度赛。说实话，她大概被 Akira 折腾过那么多次，跑{i}十{/i}圈都不用喘气。

lines.en: : That’ll be me one day, I hope.
lines.zh: : 希望有一天我也能这样。

lines.en: scene makonodowar20
: Rin, come on.
lines.zh: : Rin，别闹了。

lines.en: : What? You guys have been doing it forever and I haven’t even gotten a chance to yet. I want to increase my stamina too, you know.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你们都做了那么久了，我连一次机会都没捞着。我也想提升耐力啊。

lines.en: : Why...can’t I...move...any further?!
lines.zh: : 为什么……我……动不了了？！

lines.en: : You know, I often think I’d be much better off if my last school never sunk into the ground.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我常想，要是我原来那所学校没沉到地里去，我现在会好过得多。

lines.en: scene makonodowar21
: Hey. How’s the contest going? I was talking to Io and missed the beginning part of it.
lines.zh: : 嘿。比赛怎么样了？我刚才在跟 Io 说话，错过了开头。

lines.en: : This {i}is{/i} the beginning part of it.
lines.zh: : 这{i}就是{/i}开头啊。

lines.en: : And potentially the ending too since I’m not sure I’ve ever seen two people this out of shape before. Ain’t all you youths supposed to be full of energy and whatnot?
lines.zh: : 搞不好也快是结尾了，我还没见过两个人这么缺乏锻炼。你们这些年轻人不是应该精力充沛什么的吗？

lines.en: : It seems like less being out of shape and more just...not being accustomed to physical exertion.
lines.zh: : 与其说是缺乏锻炼，不如说……只是不习惯体力消耗。

lines.en: : Oh, Makoto’s accustomed to physical exertion alright.
lines.zh: : 哦，Makoto 对体力消耗可是很习惯的。

lines.en: scene makonodowar22
: Meaning what exactly, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 具体是什么意思，Kirin？

lines.en: : Uhh...n...nothing! That...sounded wrong.
lines.zh: : 呃……没……没什么！那……听起来不太对。

lines.en: : Do you mean...because she’s in the swim club, maybe?
lines.zh: : 你是说……因为她在游泳社？

lines.en: scene makonodowar23
: Y-Yes! That is exactly what I meant.
lines.zh: : 对……对！我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Why not mention Nodoka too then? She’s in the club. And a much better swimmer than Makoto.
lines.zh: : 那为什么不也提 Nodoka？她也在社里。而且游得比 Makoto 好多了。

lines.en: : Yeah, Nodoka’s actually great at swimming. That’s why I’m so surprised to see her not even trying. It might just be a strategy thing, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Nodoka 其实很会游泳。所以我才惊讶她连试都不试。不过也许只是战术吧。

lines.en: : Guess I just need to...brush up on my swim team knowledge then! Hahah...
lines.zh: : 看来我得……补补游泳队的知识了！哈哈哈……

lines.en: scene makonodowar24
: I...I’m gonna go find Miku or something.
lines.zh: : 我……我还是去找 Miku 什么的吧。

lines.en: scene makonodowar25
: Contest two is the cone dodge! Move through all the cones as quickly as you can without getting hit. Whoever comes out of the cone maze first wins the round!
lines.zh: : 第二项是躲锥形桶！尽可能快地穿过所有锥形桶，别被砸中。谁先从锥形桶迷宫里出来，谁就赢下这一轮！

lines.en: : Wh...Where did you even get all these traffic cones? Did you rob the public works department or something?
lines.zh: : 你……你从哪儿弄来这么多交通锥？该不会是抢了公共工程部吧？

lines.en: : They’re used for soccer, I believe. I used to gaze longingly out of the window after school in hopes of being one day crushed between the thighs of the entire team.
lines.zh: : 我记得是踢足球用的。以前放学后我总痴痴地望着窗外，盼着有一天能被整支球队的大腿夹碎。

lines.en: scene makonodowar26
: Like, one after the other? Or all at once?
lines.zh: : 是问一个接一个？还是一起上？

lines.en: : I see no reason why it can’t be both. Also, Makoto-
lines.zh: : 我看不出为什么不能两者兼有。还有，Makoto——

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. Why are you so good at this? You’re not doing, like...equations in your head to calculate movement or something, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等，等等。你为什么这么擅长？你不会在脑子里算什么方程式来算移动路线之类的吧？

lines.en: : It’s just physics. And calculating such things is no different than counting stairs as you descend them. Also, Makoto-
lines.zh: : 只是物理而已。算这些东西跟下楼梯时数台阶没什么两样。还有，Makoto——

lines.en: scene makonodowar27

: It’s totally different! Stop calculating things and just use your body! Beating me in this round after practically quitting in the first one is going to fry my brain and make it harder for me to concentrate!
lines.zh: : 完全不一样！别算了，用你的身体就行！第一项你几乎等于弃权，这一轮还赢我，会把我脑子烧坏的，让我更难集中！

lines.en: : I think it already may have since you overlooked some rather crucial wording about this contest just a moment ago.
lines.zh: : 我觉得已经烧坏了，因为你刚才漏掉了这场比赛里相当关键的一处措辞。

lines.en: : What?! What are you talking about?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你在说什么？！

lines.en: : {i}Dodge the cones without getting hit.{/i} You don’t find that phrasing odd?
lines.zh: {i}躲开锥形桶，别被砸中。{/i}你不觉得这个说法很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : She obviously just meant that we don’t want to bump into the cones! Not everything is rocket science, Nodo-
lines.zh: : 她显然只是说我们不想撞上锥形桶！又不是什么都要搞得像火箭科学一样，Nodo——

lines.en: : MAKOTO! LOOK OUT!
lines.zh: : MAKOTO！小心！

lines.en: scene makonodowar28
: For what?! I’m trying to-
lines.zh: : 小心什么？！我正想——

lines.en: scene makonodowar29
scene makonodowar30
: Guh!
lines.zh: : 呃啊！

lines.en: scene makonodowar31
scene makonodowar32
: See, this is exactly why you need to be paying attention.
lines.zh: : 看吧，这就是为什么你需要集中注意力。

lines.en: : {i}FUCK YOU AND FUCK WHOEVER THREW THAT CONE!!!!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}操你的，还有操那个扔锥形桶的家伙！！！！{/i}

lines.en: scene makonodowar33
: Can I sit on your lap?
lines.zh: : 我能坐你腿上吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Please?
lines.zh: : 求你了？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Please?
lines.zh: : 求你了？

lines.en: : Ami, no. We’re in public.
lines.zh: : Ami，不行。我们在公共场合。

lines.en: : Please?
lines.zh: : 求你了？

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : Please?
lines.zh: : 求你了？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}fine. But only for a-
lines.zh: {i}哈……{/i}好吧。但只能——

lines.en: scene makonodowar34
: Yay! And I only had to ask once.
lines.zh: : 耶！而且我只问了一次就成功了。

lines.en: : Mhm. Right.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。是吧。

lines.en: scene makonodowar35
: Hi. I’ve done some thinking over the last hour or so and, upon further reflection, I can not, in good faith, compete against this girl.
lines.zh: : 嗨。过去一个小时左右我想了很多，仔细想了想，我实在没法心安理得地跟这个女生比赛。

lines.en: : Then just do it in bad faith.
lines.zh: : 那就别心安理得地比。

lines.en: scene makonodowar36

: I can {i}try.{/i} I’m really {i}bad{/i} at bad faith, though. Like, even when I fuck with Maya, I have to spend at least thirty minutes decompressing and telling myself I’m not a bad person afterward. It really sucks.
lines.zh: : 我可以{i}试试{/i}。不过我这人真的很不擅长{i}耍坏{/i}。比方说，就算我捉弄 Maya，事后也得花至少三十分钟缓一缓，告诉自己我不是坏人。真的很烦。

lines.en: : Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: : I’m also starting to get offended that Chika’s just totally fine around me if {i}this{/i} is her reaction to meeting Nee-chan.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果 Chika 见到老姐是{i}这{/i}副反应，那她在我身边这么正常，我开始有点受伤了。

lines.en: scene makonodowar37
: Girl?...
: Yes, Chika. Girl.
lines.zh: : 对，Chika。女孩。

lines.en: scene makonodowar38
: Also, what’s Ami doing in your lap? That’s where I want to be. Where do I sign up? Is there a line? Because I’ll wait.
lines.zh: : 还有，Ami 在你腿上干什么？那儿才是我想待的地方。要上哪儿报名？要排队吗？要的话我等。

lines.en: : No line. I’m just exercising my God-given right to sit on my dad’s lap in public. He has a boner right now.
lines.zh: : 不用排队。我只是在行使上帝赋予我的权利，在公共场合坐我爸腿上。他现在勃起了。

lines.en: : No, Ami. I do not.
lines.zh: : 不，Ami。我没有。

lines.en: : He has a boner and he’s thinking about putting it inside of me while all of you are forced to watch.
lines.zh: : 他勃起了，而且他正想着在你们所有人被迫围观的情况下把它插进我身体里。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: Really, though. Where do I get in line?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。我要上哪儿排队？

lines.en: else:
scene makonodowar39
: Aww, come on! {i}Again?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 哎呀，拜托！{i}又来？！{/i}

lines.en: scene makonodowar40
: And so it all comes down to this! A test of strength between who I can only imagine are the two weakest girls in all of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 一切就都看这一局了！一场力量的较量，对手我想大概就是整个 Kumon-mi 最弱的两个女生！

lines.en: : Tell me — how’s this contest measuring up to your expectations so far, Karin?
lines.zh: : 告诉我——这场比赛到目前为止跟你预期比怎么样，Karin？

lines.en: : Poorly! But it seems like both girls are giving it their all, which is really the most important part when it comes to exercise.
lines.zh: : 差远了！不过两位姑娘似乎都拼尽全力了，说到运动，这才是最重要的部分。

lines.en: : Any guesses on who’s going to take round three now that our game is tied at one to one?
lines.zh: : 现在总比分一比一平，你猜谁会拿下第三轮？

lines.en: scene makonodowar41
: That’s a great question, Miss Imai. But maybe we should see what they have to say for themselves instead?
lines.zh: : 问得好，Imai 老师。不过也许我们该听听她们自己怎么说？

lines.en: : I am going to destroy you.
lines.zh: : 我要把你打得落花流水。

lines.en: : I concur. I will soon be destroyed.
lines.zh: : 我同意。我很快就会被打得落花流水。

lines.en: : Okay, never mind. I think Makoto is going to win.
lines.zh: : 好吧，当我没说。我觉得 Makoto 会赢。

lines.en: scene makonodowar42
: Mngh!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Makoto? Why haven’t you defeated me yet?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Makoto？你怎么还没打败我？

lines.en: : I’m...trying! But you’re...fighting back!
lines.zh: : 我……我在努力！可你……在反抗！

lines.en: : Is that not what you wanted?
lines.zh: : 这不是你想要的吗？

lines.en: : I...do! Just...s...
lines.zh: : 我是……想要！只是……好……

lines.en: : Stop...resisting!...
lines.zh: : 别……反抗了！……

lines.en: : There’s a joke to be made here but I really don’t want to be the one to make it.
lines.zh: : 这儿有个梗可以讲，但我真的不想当那个讲的人。

lines.en: : You know, the kiss offer is still on the table.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，那个亲吻的提议还有效。

lines.en: scene makonodowar43
: You think I will...take that bait just because I...hate losing?!
lines.zh: : 你以为我会……因为我……讨厌输就上钩？！

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. And honestly, I’m only bringing it up because I accidentally won the last round and am able to hold out in {i}this{/i} one due to the arm strength that tirelessly writing has bestowed unto me.
lines.zh: : 有点吧，对。说实话我提这个，只是因为上一轮我稀里糊涂赢了，而{i}这{/i}一轮我能撑住，全靠我不停写字练出来的手臂力量。

lines.en: : You are...so lucky I...tired myself out!
lines.zh: : 你……真走运，我……把自己累垮了！

lines.en: : Am I? Now, should I interpret that as you considering my offer? Or am I lucky because you haven’t wiped the floor with me?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那我该把这理解成你在考虑我的提议？还是说我走运是因为你还没把我按在地上摩擦？

lines.en: : Because, need I remind you, I {i}wanted{/i} that to happen. And I’m actually quite disappointed that it hasn’t yet.
lines.zh: : 因为，需要我提醒你吗，我{i}是希望{/i}那件事发生的。而且它到现在都没发生，我还挺失望的。

lines.en: : Then just...take the fall, damn it! I don’t even care that it...wouldn’t be a real win anymore!
lines.zh: : 那你就……输给我啊，该死！我甚至不在乎那样……就算不上真正的胜利了！

lines.en: : Oooh...that just gives me a chance to sweeten the pot then, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦……那正好给我机会加码了，不是吗？

lines.en: : You...wouldn’t...dare!
lines.zh: : 你……不敢！

lines.en: : Let’s speak privately later. I don’t think my new idea is one that should be {i}televised.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们待会儿私下说。我觉得我的新主意不太适合{i}电视直播{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m...not...a lesbian!
lines.zh: : 我……不是……同性恋！

lines.en: : And you don’t {i}have{/i} to be. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 你{i}也{/i}不一定非得是。你明白吗？

lines.en: scene makonodowar44
: No! But fuck it! I want to win and if making some sort of shady deal is the price I must pay, so be it!
lines.zh: : 不明白！但管他呢！我想赢，如果做点见不得人的交易是必须付出的代价，那就这样吧！

lines.en: : Oh, Makoto. You really do suck at losing, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哦，Makoto。你真是输不起，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes! I do! And we all know I do, so what’s the point in hiding it anymore?!
lines.zh: : 对！我就是！而且大家都知道，那还有什么好藏的？！

lines.en: : We have a deal then?
lines.zh: : 那我们成交了？

lines.en: : Fine! Yes! Whatever!
lines.zh: : 行！好！随便吧！

lines.en: : Excellent. Come find me later tonight then. I have some...{i}questions{/i} for you.
lines.zh: : 很好。那今晚晚点来找我。我有些……{i}问题{/i}要问你。

lines.en: scene noonsky
: F...Fine! Just...f...fucking...mngh!
lines.zh: : 好……好吧！只是……他……他妈的……嗯嗯！

lines.en: : I’m not even resisting anymore. Are you truly this weak?
lines.zh: : 我都不反抗了。你真有这么弱吗？

lines.en: : DIEEEEEEEEEEE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 去死eeeeeeeeeee！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: scene black
scene makonodowar45
: Well, ladies and gentlemen! It was definitely a contest! And every contest must have its winner!
lines.zh: : 好了，女士们先生们！这确实是一场比赛！而每场比赛都必须有它的赢家！

lines.en: scene makonodowar46

: Unless that contest ends in a tie! Which, sometimes, it does! But that’s normally for more informal contests. Which...I guess the Dorm Wars would actually {i}be{/i} since the Dorm Wars itself can end in a tie!
lines.zh: : 除非那场比赛打平！而有时候确实会平！不过那种情况一般出现在比较非正式的比赛里。而……我猜宿舍战争{i}就是{/i}非正式的，因为它本身也可能打平！

lines.en: : But if this new rule about Miss Imai being the winner in the event of a tie is real, doesn’t that mean it wouldn’t really be a tie at all and make this entire tangent kind of unrelated? Maybe! I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 可如果「打平时由 Imai 老师获胜」这条新规是真的，那不就等于说这根本算不上平局，我这一整段跑题也就有点不相干了吗？也许吧！我不知道！

lines.en: scene makonodowar47
: But there isn’t a tie today because {i}today’s{/i} winner is Makoto Miyamura! Which brings the score of the sixth annual Dorm Wars to 1-0 in favor of the first floor!
lines.zh: : 不过今天没有平局，因为{i}今天的{/i}赢家是 Makoto Miyamura！第六届宿舍战争的比分就此变成 1 比 0，一楼领先！

lines.en: : Do you have any words for the fans back home, Makoto? Or maybe your mom, who I’ve heard loves you very much?
lines.zh: : Makoto，有什么话要对家里的粉丝说吗？或者对你妈妈——我听说她非常爱你？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: scene makonodowar48
: None at all? Not even a little one? Like a...{i}thank you?{/i} Or something like that?
lines.zh: : 一句都没有？连一小句也没有？比如……{i}谢谢{/i}？之类的？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Will you at least tell your mom you love her in the event that she’s watching back at home?
lines.zh: : 万一你妈在家看电视，你至少愿意跟她说你爱她吗？

lines.en: scene makonodowar49
: No!
: Makoto. Tell your mom you love her right this instant or I’ll take your point away.
lines.zh: : Makoto。现在就说你爱你妈，否则我就把你的分数扣掉。

lines.en: scene makonodowar50
: Y...You can’t do that! Surely, that’s against the rules!
lines.zh: : 你……你不能这么做！这肯定违反规则！

lines.en: : Maybe. But so is {i}buying{/i} a win and I turned the other cheek to that! Now tell your mom you love her or Nodoka wins instead!
lines.zh: : 也许吧。可{i}买{/i}通胜利同样违规，那个我睁一只眼闭一只眼了！现在说你爱你妈，不然赢家改成 Nodoka！

lines.en: scene makonodowar51
: Mmngh...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯……

lines.en: : {size=-5}I love you, Mom.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-5}我爱你，妈。{/size}

lines.en: scene makonodowar52
: Yay! That concludes our first competition!
lines.zh: : 耶！第一项比赛到此结束！

lines.en: : Join us after another word from our sponsors to find out who comes out on top of Kaori Kadowaki’s Chaotic Cooking Class Competition! See you next time!
lines.zh: : 一段赞助商广告之后，请继续收看谁会在 Kaori Kadowaki 的混乱烹饪课比赛中拔得头筹！下次见！
